title: Funnel: Fix some leaks
description:
Set the funnel ops to nullptr when deleting the GUI part, and then check
if it's null when retrieving it in the Lua code. This removes the
concern mentioned in the FunnelStatistics destructor comments.

Also prevent a console warning about a wildcard disconnect disconnecting
from a destroyed() signal, which can cause crashes etc.:

 ** (wireshark:623458) 18:01:22.779848 [GUI WARNING] -- QObject::disconnect: wildcard call disconnects from destroyed signal of FunnelTextDialog::FunnelTextDialog

Fix #21307

AI-Assisted: no
